_doc: ADR-0075 D-C sunset trigger durable state host (grill-t15 D-002): the parallel zero-observation counter lives in this git-tracked artifact inside the ADR-0061 anchors regen-and-diff chain; the decision ledger degrades to an append-only audit trail and is not the state host; no registry row is opened (defer-0060 as counter host was rejected, D-002). Single writer = round disposition; telemetry produces evidence only and never writes state (measurement vs bookkeeping separation).
cadence: quarterly, aligned to the defer-0055 check-in tide but with an independent lifecycle - this counter is not a field of defer-0055's row and does not die with it (watchdog independence, ADR-0075 D-C path A)

semantics.organic_positive: organic_events > 0 at a check-in resets consecutive_zeros to 0 AND appends a reset_events entry - a reset is never a silent overwrite
semantics.missed_check_in: a quarterly check-in not executed freezes consecutive_zeros and appends a missed_check_ins entry - absence of observation is not an observation of zero (tighten-only operationalization of 'consecutive quarterly check-ins', grill-t15 D-002)
semantics.activation: when consecutive_zeros reaches n_target the ledger records the event first, then activation {date, ledger_ref} is set - a one-way latch. Activation only SUGGESTS the already-scheduled strategic review (ADR-0035 D6); it never amends, closes, or exempts anything
semantics.single_writer: round disposition writes this file; telemetry scripts only produce the evidence_ref payloads
